summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running tests, black, or flake8. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path; added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst; added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. A line-length check found no lines over 120 columns. Choices beyond the spec: non-list entries under the key and non-object top-level JSON raise ValueError; malformed JSON propagates the json decode error (a ValueError subclass). Nothing committed.
